permissions.comment: The window's own border and shadow are drawn by the OS, not by the page, so the only way they follow the app's light/dark choice is to tell the window about it.

The title bar is drawn by the page (`src/titlebar.ts`), so dragging the window is a press on one of our elements rather than on a caption Windows owns. Paired with `internal-toggle-maximize`, which is the double-click on that same bar.

The three buttons on that bar. `is-maximized` is what tells the middle one which of the two shapes to draw, and it is asked again on every resize because the window can be maximised without it — Win+Up, or a drag to the top of the screen.
F11. Paired with `is-fullscreen` because the toggle reads the window's own state rather than keeping its own.

Opening a project folder in Explorer. A project can live anywhere the user keeps one, so the scope cannot be narrower than the whole filesystem; the only paths passed are ones already in the recents list.
